Vendored copies so the site runs offline.
- three.min.js: Three.js r128 (MIT), from the three@0.128.0 npm package.
- GLTFLoader.js: GLTFLoader from three@0.128.0 examples (MIT).
fonts/: Bangers, Fredoka One and Nunito, latin subsets, from @fontsource packages (OFL).
- mp4-muxer.js: mp4-muxer 5.1.3 (MIT, Vanilagy), from the npm package. Used by the Edit Maker to write MP4 files. LICENSE in mp4-muxer-LICENSE.txt.
